- `scripts/workflow_lint.py:3512` (the FI3 waiver arm `if dc is not None and dc.start() <= m.start(): continue`): the waiver keys on the presence of ANY `git -C` at a lower char offset than the matched reset — not that the `-C` qualifies the SAME command.   - Impact: a false-negative in the guard's spec-drift-prevention purpose — a future spec author writing a `-C`-status-chained-then-bare-reset line evades the check. **Zero live impact**: the only live in-scope `git -C` line is the single-command sanctioned form (`analyzer.md:481`); no chained-command shape exists in scope. This is a second member of the same "line-oriented, not a shell AST" under-match family the plan already documents for the FI5 `\`-continuation (§6 kill-criteria / test docstring), so it is consistent with the documented scope rather than a regression.
  - Fix (optional tightening, does not block): require the `git -C` to be the immediate command prefix of the matched reset — e.g. reject the waiver if a command separator (`&&`, `;`, `|`) sits between `dc.end()` and `m.start()`, or match the sanctioned form as a single `git\s+-C\s+\S+\s+.*reset...--hard` prefix anchored at `m.start()`.
